entry.question: Formalize a conditional effective kinetic evolution whose vector field is g^2 times a collision operator independent of g. Under explicit existence and uniqueness and g nonzero assumptions, prove the exact solution time rescaling D_g(t)=D_1(g^2*t), then derive the corresponding compatible hitting-time scaling. Clearly label this as a theorem about the effective kinetic model, not a derivation from the microscopic disordered lattice. Define the microscopic T_eq asymptotic scaling only as a named conjecture Prop with no axiom and no proof obligation.
